summary: r001 BRD-053: lop de xuat AI co hop dong. Bo nao AI (LLM local qua HTTP OpenAI-compatible, vendor CLI codex/claude/opencode/antigravity o che do chi doc, hoac heuristic khong LLM lam doi chung) CHI de xuat 'changes' gene trong mien grammar + gia thuyet; schema ProposalResponse additionalProperties=false nen moi khoa phan quyet (verdict/pass/feasible...) do bo nao tu them lam ca cau tra loi MALFORMED, khong duoc danh gia. HAI TANG AUTHORITY tach bach trong tung ban ghi: (1) CLAIM chi tu design_study.assess_candidate (schema -> L0 -> applicability registry neo hash -> site/evidence -> BUILTIN_L1 -> verifier); (2) PHAN HOI VAT LY tu evaluate_candidate + INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER (violations/utilization/objectives) — cung duong design_loop/rl_env/surrogate dang dung; khong phai claim. PHAT HIEN khi noi day (2026-09-04): gene neo Super-T qua assess_candidate(L1_STRUCTURAL, site_profile=None) bi BLOCKED boi APP-EVIDENCE-001 (domain_evidence PARTIAL -> L1 phai BLOCKED) va SITE-001 (chua co ho so site, G0) trong khi evaluate_candidate cho feasible=true, util ~0.98. Lop nay KHONG noi cong, KHONG gia lap site: claim cua moi gene Super-T qua lop nay hom nay la IDEA; 'verifier-kha thi o L1' la phan hoi. Ho chi L0 theo registry (box_girder_parametric_v1) khong bao gio goi evaluate_candidate (neu goi truc tiep no van chay L1 cho hop va cho so phi vat ly). Pre-registration (cau hoi, objective, ngan sach, tieu chi thanh cong/bac bo, seed, adapter) khoa + bam SHA-256 truoc vong 1; moi vong ghi request/response hash, adapter status, tung proposal + ket qua; ket qua am, trung lap, ngoai mien deu duoc dem va giu; bao cao validate theo ProposalSessionReport va tai lap voi adapter tat dinh. Adapter HTTP: endpoint/model tu tham so hoac DYLIGHT_LLM_ENDPOINT/DYLIGHT_LLM_MODEL; API key chi doc tu DYLIGHT_LLM_API_KEY luc gui, bao cao chi ghi host (test khang dinh khoa khong ro). Adapter CLI: run_provider(writable=False) (codex --sandbox read-only). scripts/propose_cli.py chay doc lap (khong sua cli.py/serve_lab.py vi thuoc BRD-051/052). docs/09 tra loi cau hoi 'phong lab ao can gi de dua bo nao AI vao sang tao': ma tran nang luc, khoang trong (SOLVER_MIDAS_CIVIL ABSENT, ENGINEER_APPROVED_KNOWLEDGE ABSENT), kien truc, bat bien, lo trinh BRD-054..058. Test: 19 ca hermetic (khong goi LLM that). CHAY THAT (2026-09-05, ngoai test, bao cao trong .tmp/proposer/): heuristic 3 vong tren gene neo -> 7 luot, 4 am, khong ha duoc cost 2072.94 (gene neo la oracle grammar A/B) -> gia thuyet bi bac; nao Claude (cli:claude, chi doc) 2 vong -> vong 1 MALFORMED vi LLM ghi direction 'unchanged' ngoai enum (da them 'unchanged' vao schema + test, gia tri la van bi loai), vong 2 OK voi 3 de xuat lap luan dung so lieu nhung deu kem DG-3/ban 175 mm -> L0 tu choi (claim REJECTED, khong mo L1), ket qua am giu nguyen; nao GPT (cli:codex) 2 vong UNAVAILABLE vi codex-cli 0.148.0 khong ho tro model gpt-6-astra trong ~/.codex/config.toml (loi moi truong, phien dung sach). Full suite (chay lai sau khi sua enum): 1907 pass, 4 skip, 0 fail, pytest exit 0 (dem tu log day du .tmp/lab-review/full_suite_brd053_r001.txt, sha256 d3fc5cedf47dae4da0e1e548f52de5d039d414aa52b270630569e5a1498dcf36).
